Test body sets `__match_args__ = ma` inside the `@dataclass` decorated class body. fixture_taint_summary: 285 F2P split into two groups: (A) All 282 TestPatma.test_patma_NNN methods from Lib/test/test_patma.py (the canonical PEP 634 test suite). Pre-state: test_patma.py uses match/case syntax the pre-PR parser cannot recognise → entire module fails to import → all 282 methods ERROR. Post-state: solution.patch extends Grammar/python.gram + regenerates Parser/parser.c + adds MATCH_* opcodes → all 282 PASS. (B) 3 pre-existing methods touched by the PR: (i) TestNamedTuple.test_match_args (asserts namedtuple.__match_args__ tuple), (ii) TestMatchArgs.test_match_args (asserts auto-generated dataclass.__match_args__), (iii) AST_Tests.test_snippets (helper _assertTrueorder now reads ast_node.__match_args__ on every node). Each of the 3 fails with AttributeError at pre-state.
